text:
Last night when I was sleeping

I dreamed, blessed illusion!,

that a fountain flowed

inside my heart.


Tell me, by what hidden channel,

water, do you come to me,

spring of new life

from which I never drank?


Last night when I was sleeping

I dreamed, blessed illusion!,

that I had a beehive

inside my heart;


and the golden bees

were making there,

with old bitterness,

white wax and sweet honey.


Last night when I was sleeping

I dreamed, blessed illusion!,

that a burning sun was shining

inside my heart.


It was burning because it gave

warmths of a red hearth,

and it was sun because it lit

and because it brought tears.


Last night when I was sleeping

I dreamed, blessed illusion!,

that what I had

inside my heart was God.

translation.title: Last Night When I Was Sleeping...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the recurring dream refrain and the heart's movement from water to hive, sun, and God.
